name: Firedrill
description: Simulate AI agents across scenarios, explore behavior and inspect saved evidence through MCP, CLI or SDK, while keeping the agent runner in your own repository or CI.

skills.name: Prepare Scenarios
skills.description: Prepare reusable scenarios grounded in an agent's task, with optional checks, semantic assessment and repeated trials.

skills.name: Inspect Run Evidence
skills.description: Inspect retained run reports, recorded activity and assessment evidence without equating execution completion with task quality.

skills.name: Manage Synthetic Tools
skills.description: Select and manage synthetic dependencies with datasets and reset boundaries, without silently using live vendor services.
